_comment: Copy to instagram-graph.json and fill in. The real file is gitignored. Never put a token in a file that is committed.
_token_note: Preferred: export IG_GRAPH_ACCESS_TOKEN. Otherwise point access_token_file at a file OUTSIDE this repo.
_app_note: Only needed to exchange a short-lived token for a long-lived one.

gcs._note: Uploading and signing run through the gcloud CLI, so `gcloud auth login` must be done.
gcs._signing_note: Impersonation keeps no private key on disk and is the only option when the org enforces constraints/iam.disableServiceAccountKeyCreation. Grant yourself roles/iam.serviceAccountTokenCreator on this service account.
